title: Identification of two novel variants, c.-35A>T and c.[-35A>T, 725T>G], in the FUT1 gene in a patient exhibiting the para-Bombay phenotype.
authors: Intharanut, Kamphon; Khumsuk, Piyathida; Chidtrakoon, Sarisa; Glab-Ampai, Kantaphon; Nathalang, Oytip
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold2/HDOCK建模和DynaMut2预测FUT1基因变异对蛋白-DNA互作及转录因子结合的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA界面但核心是血型表型，非典型TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Reduced or absent H antigens on red cells with the (para-)Bombay phenotype can arise from FUT1 gene mutations, impacting the structure and function of 1,2-L-fucosyltransferase 1 (1,2-L-FucT1). Here, we identified the novel mutations in one patient displaying the para-Bombay phenotype and examined the potential molecular mechanisms underlying this phenotype. MATERIALS AND METHODS: ABH antigens and antibodies were detected in patient's blood and saliva using serological methods. The genotypes of ABO, FUT1, and FUT2 were imputed using the genetic variations discovered in the whole exome sequencing data. Three-dimensional (3D) models of FUT1 variants were built using Deepmind's AlphaFold2 and HDOCK, and the possible effects of the variants were predicted to evaluate using DynaMut2 and Polyphen-2. RESULTS: Serological analysis confirmed the para-Bombay B phenotype producing anti-HI and exhibiting normal genotypes ABO*B.01/O.01.02 and FUT2*01.09/01.09. Remarkably, the phenotype is caused by a compound heterozygous genotype: one allele containing the novel c.-35A>T mutation and the known c.725T>G mutation (p.Leu242Arg) of FUT1, and the other allele containing the c.-35A>T mutation. From the computerized stimulation analysis, p.Arg242 of the FUT1 variant may be detrimental, destabilizing, and probably damaging to 1,2-L-FucT1, although not altering the 3D structure of the entire enzyme. The c.-35A>T promoter DNA left at the binding interface of both ZID and c-Rel transcription factors may enable regulation of 1,2-L-FucT1 function at gene promoters. CONCLUSION: We identified the two novel variants, c.-35A>T and c.[-35A>T, 725T>G], in the FUT1 causing the para-Bombay phenotype. This finding may clarify the molecular mechanisms and enhance blood transfusion safety.
abstract_zh: 背景：红细胞上H抗原减少或缺失导致的（副）孟买表型可源于FUT1基因突变，影响1,2-L-岩藻糖基转移酶1（1,2-L-FucT1）的结构和功能。在此，我们在一名表现出副孟买表型的患者中鉴定了新突变，并探讨了该表型潜在的分子机制。材料与方法：采用血清学方法检测患者血液和唾液中的ABH抗原和抗体。利用全外显子组测序数据中发现的遗传变异，推断ABO、FUT1和FUT2的基因型。使用Deepmind的AlphaFold2和HDOCK构建FUT1变异体的三维（3D）模型，并利用DynaMut2和Polyphen-2预测和评估变异可能产生的影响。结果：血清学分析确认了副孟买B表型，产生抗-HI，并表现出正常的基因型ABO*B.01/O.01.02和FUT2*01.09/01.09。值得注意的是，该表型由复合杂合基因型引起：一个等位基因包含FUT1的新突变c.-35A>T和已知突变c.725T>G（p.Leu242Arg），另一个等位基因包含c.-35A>T突变。计算机模拟分析显示，FUT1变异体的p.Arg242可能对1,2-L-FucT1有害、不稳定且可能具有损伤性，尽管未改变整个酶的3D结构。c.-35A>T启动子DNA位于ZID和c-Rel转录因子的结合界面，可能使1,2-L-FucT1功能在基因启动子水平受到调控。结论：我们在FUT1中鉴定了两个新变异c.-35A>T和c.[-35A>T, 725T>G]，导致副孟买表型。这一发现可能阐明分子机制并提高输血安全性。
